name: Macr
description:
The complete macOS experience for your Linux desktop.

A macOS menu bar and dock for GNOME. The menu bar has the Apple-style logo menu, the focused app's name and menu, a Window menu and a macOS clock on a translucent bar. The dock has frosted glass, magnification, a Trash, autohide and the genie minimize. Launchpad shows every app on Super, and Spotlight searches apps, files and settings with Ctrl+Space. Quick settings become the macOS Control Center, with Focus, app icons your theme lacks get a macOS tile, and volume and brightness show as a pill at the top right.
